feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Trump gives primetime speech at GOP convention, promising payout if Republicans win
entry.summary: President Trump kicked off the Republican midterm convention with a primetime speech, outlining the Republican message and promising Americans a payout if the GOP wins the upcoming election.

entry.title: Veteran pollster shares takeaways from Trump's convention speech
entry.summary: Veteran pollster and political consultant Frank Luntz gives an analysis of President Trump's speech at the Republicans' midterm convention.

entry.title: NYC firefighters want answers after release of post-9/11 air quality documents
entry.summary: New York City's firefighters are demanding answers after the city released documents showing how toxic the air quality was following the attacks on the World Trade Center on 9/11.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Trump kicks off Republican midterm convention with primetime speech, Missouri Supreme Court to decide whether to hold secretary of state in contempt, Apple unveils new foldable phone.

entry.title: Sandra Bullock on 'Practical Magic 2' and the spell the original film has on fans
entry.summary: Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman starred in the 1998 film "Practical Magic," which has since become an "occult" hit. NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with Bullock about the long-delayed "Practical Magic 2."

entry.title: Maine Gov. Janet Mills on the effect the U.S.-Canada trade war will have on the state
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin asks Maine's Democratic Governor Janet Mills about the impact of the escalating U.S.-Canada trade war on her state.

entry.title: Trump officials revive a bid to alter the U.S. census and reshape voting maps
entry.summary: The Trump administration is making a new push to exclude millions of U.S. residents from a key census count that the 14th Amendment says must include the "whole number of persons in each state."

entry.title: Immigration court's unusual locations raise due process concerns
entry.summary: Unusual locations for immigration court hearings appear to be another tactic in a broader strategy to short-circuit immigrants' already-limited due process.

entry.title: UN peacekeepers give NPR a rare look behind Israeli lines
entry.summary: NPR accompanies UN peacekeepers behind Israeli lines as Israel expands its occupation of South Lebanon following a U.S.-brokered ceasefire.

entry.title: Missouri secretary of state could be held in contempt over redistricting map fight
entry.summary: The Missouri Supreme Court is holding a hearing to determine if the Republican secretary of state should be held in contempt of court for using a redistricting map it rejected.
